announcements.title: How to enable announcement notifications
announcements.body:
To receive Vedanta Yojana announcements as push notifications on Android, notifications must be enabled in TWO places:

1. On your phone: Open Android Settings → Apps → Vedanta Yojana → Notifications, and allow notifications.

2. Inside Vedanta Yojana: Open the app → Settings → Announcement notifications, then tap Enable notifications. Wait for the app to confirm that notifications are enabled.

Both steps are required. Allowing notifications in Android Settings alone does not subscribe your device to Vedanta Yojana announcements.

Notifications are optional. You can disable them at any time in the app's Settings. New announcements will still appear in the app even if push notifications are off.

ta.title: அறிவிப்பு அறிவுறுத்தல்களை இயக்குவது எப்படி
ta.body:
வேதாந்த யோஜனாவின் அறிவிப்புகளை Android தொலைபேசியில் பெற, இரண்டு இடங்களில் அறிவிப்புகளை இயக்க வேண்டும்:

1. தொலைபேசியில்: Android அமைப்புகள் → செயலிகள் → Vedanta Yojana → அறிவிப்புகள் என்பதற்குச் சென்று அறிவிப்புகளை அனுமதிக்கவும்.

2. Vedanta Yojana செயலியில்: அமைப்புகள் → அறிவிப்பு அறிவுறுத்தல்கள் என்பதற்குச் சென்று அறிவிப்புகளை இயக்கு என்பதைத் தட்டவும். அறிவிப்புகள் இயக்கப்பட்டதாக உறுதிப்படுத்தப்படும் வரை காத்திருக்கவும்.

இரண்டு படிகளும் அவசியம். தொலைபேசியில் மட்டும் அனுமதி வழங்குவது போதாது.

அறிவிப்புகள் விருப்பத்திற்குரியவை. அவற்றைச் செயலியின் அமைப்புகளில் எப்போது வேண்டுமானாலும் நிறுத்தலாம். அறிவிப்புகள் நிறுத்தப்பட்டிருந்தாலும் புதிய செய்திகள் செயலியில் தொடர்ந்து தோன்றும்.

kn.title: ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಗಳ ಪುಷ್ ಅಧಿಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಕ್ರಿಯಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ
kn.body:
ವೇದಾಂತ ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಗಳ ಪುಷ್ ಅಧಿಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು Android ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಎರಡು ಕಡೆ ಸಕ್ರಿಯಗೊಳಿಸಬೇಕು:

1. ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ: Android Settings → Apps → Vedanta Yojana → Notifications ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಧಿಸೂಚನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನುಮತಿ ನೀಡಿ.

2. Vedanta Yojana ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ: Settings → Announcement notifications ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು Enable notifications ಒತ್ತಿರಿ. ಅಧಿಸೂಚನೆಗಳು ಸಕ್ರಿಯಗೊಂಡಿವೆ ಎಂಬ ದೃಢೀಕರಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕಾಯಿರಿ.

ಎರಡೂ ಹಂತಗಳು ಅಗತ್ಯ. ಫೋನ್‌ನ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅನುಮತಿ ನೀಡಿದರೆ ಸಾಕಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

ಅಧಿಸೂಚನೆಗಳು ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ. ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ನ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವಾಗ ಬೇಕಾದರೂ ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯಗೊಳಿಸಬಹುದು. ಅವು ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಗಳು ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

hi.title: घोषणाओं की पुश सूचनाएँ कैसे चालू करें
hi.body:
Android पर वेदांत योजना की घोषणाओं की पुश सूचनाएँ पाने के लिए दो जगह सूचनाएँ चालू करनी होंगी:

1. फ़ोन में: Android Settings → Apps → Vedanta Yojana → Notifications खोलें और सूचनाओं की अनुमति दें।

2. Vedanta Yojana ऐप में: Settings → Announcement notifications खोलें और Enable notifications दबाएँ। सूचनाएँ चालू होने की पुष्टि होने तक प्रतीक्षा करें।

दोनों चरण आवश्यक हैं। केवल फ़ोन की सेटिंग में अनुमति देना पर्याप्त नहीं है।

सूचनाएँ वैकल्पिक हैं। आप ऐप की सेटिंग में इन्हें कभी भी बंद कर सकते हैं। पुश सूचनाएँ बंद होने पर भी नई घोषणाएँ ऐप में दिखाई देंगी।

te.title: ప్రకటనల పుష్ నోటిఫికేషన్‌లను ఎలా ప్రారంభించాలి
te.body:
Android ఫోన్‌లో వేదాంత యోజన ప్రకటనల పుష్ నోటిఫికేషన్‌లను పొందాలంటే రెండు చోట్ల వాటిని ప్రారంభించాలి:

1. ఫోన్‌లో: Android Settings → Apps → Vedanta Yojana → Notifications తెరిచి నోటిఫికేషన్‌లను అనుమతించండి.

2. Vedanta Yojana యాప్‌లో: Settings → Announcement notifications తెరిచి Enable notifications నొక్కండి. నోటిఫికేషన్‌లు ప్రారంభమయ్యాయని నిర్ధారణ వచ్చే వరకు వేచి ఉండండి.

ఈ రెండు దశలూ అవసరం. ఫోన్ సెట్టింగ్‌లలో మాత్రమే అనుమతి ఇవ్వడం సరిపోదు.

నోటిఫికేషన్‌లు ఐచ్ఛికం. యాప్ సెట్టింగ్‌లలో ఎప్పుడైనా ఆపవచ్చు. పుష్ నోటిఫికేషన్‌లు ఆపినా కొత్త ప్రకటనలు యాప్‌లో కనిపిస్తాయి.

announcements.title: Android notification delivery test
announcements.body: This is a one-time test of Vedanta Yojana's optional Android announcement notifications. If you received a notification in your Android notification tray and tapping it opened this announcement inside the app, push delivery is working on your device. No action is required. Thank you for helping us verify this feature.

announcements.title: Android 1.3.0 is available — please update
announcements.body:
A new Android version of Vedanta Yojana is available. Version 1.3.0 adds optional push notifications for announcements in your chosen language.

Visit vedantayojana.org on your Android device or use the download link below to install the latest APK over your existing app. Do not uninstall the old version first; your saved bookmarks and settings should remain available.

After updating, open Settings and enable announcement notifications if you would like to receive them. Notifications are optional, and older Android versions can still read this announcement in the app.

announcements.title: Deepavali 2026 — Observance Dates in India & Overseas
announcements.body:
Deepavali observances follow specific kāla-niyamas, the prescribed ritual windows at your location. The tithi prevailing at sunrise alone does not determine every observance.

Based on Vedanta Yojana’s traditional Siddhānta calculations, the dates for November 2026 are:

India
Deepavali Snānam: Sunday, 8 November
Amāvāsyā Tarpaṇam: Sunday, 8 November

US cities checked: New York, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Phoenix, Los Angeles, Seattle and Honolulu
Deepavali Snānam: Saturday, 7 November
Amāvāsyā Tarpaṇam: Sunday, 8 November

European cities checked: London, Paris, Berlin, Rome, Athens and Helsinki
Deepavali Snānam: Sunday, 8 November
Amāvāsyā Tarpaṇam: Sunday, 8 November

Australian cities checked: Perth, Adelaide, Darwin, Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne
Deepavali Snānam: Sunday, 8 November
Amāvāsyā Tarpaṇam: Monday, 9 November

New Zealand cities checked: Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch
Deepavali Snānam: Sunday, 8 November
Amāvāsyā Tarpaṇam: Monday, 9 November

Deepavali Snānam — before sunrise

The app determines Deepavali using Chaturdaśī at Aruṇodaya, 96 minutes before local sunrise. Perform the customary oil bath during the applicable pre-dawn period while Chaturdaśī prevails.

London and Paris: Chaturdaśī ends before sunrise on Sunday, 8 November. Complete the snānam within these approximate local windows:

• London: 5:36–6:27 AM
• Paris: 6:18–7:27 AM

Amāvāsyā Tarpaṇam — the applicable afternoon

The app assigns tarpaṇam to the day with the greatest Amāvāsyā coverage during aparāhṇa, the fourth fifth of local daylight.

This gives Sunday, 8 November, across India and in the US and European cities listed, and Monday, 9 November, in the Australian and New Zealand cities listed.

In Perth, the calculated Monday window is approximately 1:21–3:14 PM, ending when Amāvāsyā concludes.

Deepavali lamps — Sunday evening, 8 November

The calculated tithi timings support lighting Deepavali lamps on Sunday evening, 8 November, across India and in all the overseas cities listed. Where Lakshmi Pūjā forms part of your family’s practice, follow its customary local timing.

Bengaluru timings

The dates above apply throughout India, but these clock times are specific to Bengaluru:

Sunday, 8 November
• Deepavali snānam: approximately 4:43–6:19 AM
• Amāvāsyā tarpaṇam: approximately 1:12–3:29 PM
• Evening lamps: around local sunset, approximately 5:47 PM

Please follow your location’s timings. Sunrise, sunset, Aruṇodaya and aparāhṇa vary by city. Select your location in the Panchangam; do not use Bengaluru’s clock times elsewhere or directly convert them into overseas ritual windows.

These are calculated dates and approximate windows. Follow the explicit guidance of your Āchārya, Maṭham’s pañchāṅgam and established family tradition.

May Shri Mahālakshmi and Sriman Narayana bless all with peace, protection and well-being.

announcements.title: New book: Sri Vishnu Sahasranaama Anubhavam
announcements.body: All thousand names of Sri Vishnu, explained one by one following Sri Parasara Bhattar's commentary, with every shloka and the Phala Shruti. You can also read the stotram itself in Sanskrit, Kannada, English, Telugu or Tamil.

announcements.title: Android app 1.1.0: please install this update
announcements.body: This release needs a one-time install. Tap "Update available" at the top of Home, or download it below. Your bookmarks and settings are kept, and future updates arrive automatically again.

announcements.title: A fuller Panchangam, for any city and any day
announcements.body: Choose any city in the world and pick any date. The Tithi and Nakshatram rows now show when each one changes during the day, and the observances published by Srimad Andavan Ashramam appear on their dates.

announcements.title: Blogs are now in the Library
announcements.body: Āzhwār Vaibhavam, Nityasūri Vaibhavam and Temples and Festivals can now be read in the Library, with photos, cover artwork and translations.

announcements.title: The daily Sankalpam, in your language
announcements.body: The Sankalpam is now written in the language and script you read the app in: Tamil, Kannada, Hindi, Telugu or English.

announcements.title: Telugu in the Android app
announcements.body: Version 1.0.3 of the Android app adds Telugu, including Telugu Pasurams for all 108 Divya Desams. From this version on, new content and fixes arrive automatically without reinstalling.
